correctness.rationale: The 3D Gauss-completion gives |S|=q²+epsilon q; a proved Salié identity gives F(ξ)=q epsilon sum_{v²=rQ*(ξ)} psi(v) for ξ nonzero; exact dual quadratic value multiplicities and prime-field trace fibers yield the complete absolute Fourier sum. Both endpoint norms are attained by standard convolution test functions, and the Hermitian corollary follows by a trace-one affine-sphere isomorphism. A standalone checker verified all coefficients, multiplicities, Parseval and norms for q=3,5,7,11,9,25,27, both epsilon types. Finite tests corroborate and do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The indicator Wiener norm equals the exact sharp ell1/ellinfinity spectral-projection amplification. It is a natural operator invariant of every nonzero nondegenerate quadratic shell in three variables, classified uniformly by one discriminant sign over infinitely many fields. The formula detects prime-characteristic trace arithmetic, exact kernel sparsity, sharp extension asymptotics, and a canonical finite unitary orbit; no arbitrary finite slice is chosen. A decay estimate cannot determine this total absolute sum.
